g.text: Every known connection is drawn. Wire colour = confidence; solid = verified (photo, confirmed, measured), dashed = datasheet or assumed:

g.desc: Every known connection is drawn. Wire colour = confidence; solid = verified (photo, confirmed, measured), dashed = datasheet or assumed:

g.text: measured — Checked on the board with a meter.

g.desc: measured — Checked on the board with a meter.

g.text: confirmed — Silkscreen label, a wire seen soldered to the pad, or a measurement in REPAIR_LOG.md.

g.desc: confirmed — Silkscreen label, a wire seen soldered to the pad, or a measurement in REPAIR_LOG.md.

g.text: photo — Trace, copper area or tinned strip followed in a close-up photo.

g.desc: photo — Trace, copper area or tinned strip followed in a close-up photo.

g.text: datasheet — Pin function from the part's datasheet; the part number itself is read from the photo.

g.desc: datasheet — Pin function from the part's datasheet; the part number itself is read from the photo.

g.text: assumed — Standard circuit practice or placement only. Treat as a hypothesis.

g.desc: assumed — Standard circuit practice or placement only. Treat as a hypothesis.

g.text: Open pins are UNKNOWN, not unconnected. Generated from model.yaml and annotations.json.

g.desc: Open pins are UNKNOWN, not unconnected. Generated from model.yaml and annotations.json.
